page_title: FIO 1-2 ACM | Fiorentina v AC Milan 30/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' A quickly taken corner by AC Milan.

90+4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Pietro Terracciano. The referee signals a corner kick to AC Milan.
90+3' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) will miss the next game.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Fikayo Tomori (AC Milan) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
89' Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
88' Lucas Martinez Quarta goes off the pitch and Antonin Barak (Fiorentina) comes on.
88' Jonathan Ikone comes off the pitch to be replaced by Riccardo Sottil (Fiorentina).
85' 16:13 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
82' Stefano Pioli has decided to substitute Olivier Giroud and he is replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
82' Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
79' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle. Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) commits a foul after dangerous play.
79' It will be a substitution. M'Bala Nzola (Fiorentina) is ready to enter the pitch as Lucas Beltran walks off.
76' A goal, which was scored by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan), was disallowed due to offside.
75' The corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is cleared away by the defence.
74' The corner from Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) is hurriedly cleared.
73' The substitution has been made. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) has replaced Samuel Chukwueze.

73' What a wasted opportunity by Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Maignan makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
72' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mike Maignan is well positioned and punches the ball away.
70' Fiorentina take a short corner kick.
69' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Christian Kouame will be replaced by Nicolas Gonzalez (Fiorentina).
69' That's the end of the game for Dodo, who is replaced by Michael Kayode (Fiorentina).
67' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
64' A corner kick by Fiorentina is thwarted by the well prepared Mike Maignan (AC Milan).

64' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots to the top right corner, but Mike Maignan pulls off an exquisite save to deny him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Fiorentina are going to take it.
63' Stefano Pioli has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yunus Musah (AC Milan) replacing Tijjani Reijnders.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Noah Okafor (AC Milan) comes onto the pitch for Rafael Leao.
62' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

61' What a sweet touch by Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot which goes towards the left post, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to thwart him! The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.

59' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Mike Maignan pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.

57' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. AC Milan are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
53' 1 - 2 Rafael Leao (AC Milan) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Pietro Terracciano with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:2.
50' 1 - 1 Goal! Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
47' 0 - 1 Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low in the middle of the goal.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Stefano Pioli gives a chance to Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) and Malick Thiaw is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
44' Rafael Leao plays a short pass through to Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar.
43' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out.
42' Alfred Duncan (Fiorentina) commits a rough foul. Fabio Maresca stops the game and makes a call.
40' 1:5 – this is the current number of shots on target.
37' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle as Rafael Leao (AC Milan) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
34' The corner kick from Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

33' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Pietro Terracciano sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the left post. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
33' Pietro Terracciano pulls off a great save to deny Rafael Leao (AC Milan), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner.
30' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
29' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
28' Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina) gets there first and whips in a shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
28' Fiorentina work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

27' Andrea Belotti (Fiorentina) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and drills it towards the right post. Unfortunately for him, Mike Maignan makes a great save to stop his effort. Fiorentina force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
27' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Jonathan Ikone (Fiorentina), but the defence gets it clear.
25' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
24' Lucas Martinez Quarta (Fiorentina) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
22' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
21' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
18' The resulting corner from Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

17' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Pietro Terracciano shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee points to the corner flag and AC Milan will take a corner.
15' Flag up against Rafael Leao (AC Milan). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
13' Cristiano Biraghi (Fiorentina) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
12' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) misses a big opportunity to score after striking the ball wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
9' A pass by Rafael Leao (AC Milan) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
8' Pietro Terracciano pulls off a great save to deny Olivier Giroud (AC Milan), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
4' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Olivier Giroud (AC Milan), but it's just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
3' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) is about to take a corner kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Fiorentina will kick the game off.
Fabio Maresca got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
